item.title: Small Caps & the Leading Line
item.description: When using small caps in a leading line and you have what would normally be capitalized letters within it, (for example, someones name) do you make those normal sized capitol letters in line the small caps, or just all lowercase small caps? What is best practice for this, which is more traditional…
